item.description:
TabTab 2.2 – A fresh look and smoother switching

  • Mouse activation has been reworked to expose a handle before expansion
  • Added a new setting to show only windows and tabs on the active Space
  • Improved reliability for browser tab tracking
  • Fixed favicons getting out of sync when navigating between websites or reordering tabs
  • Added standard keyboard shortcuts for Settings and Quit, and fixed a crash when opening Settings through TabTab
  • Redesigned Settings, inspired by Alcove!

Thanks for using TabTab! ❤️
